regressions.issue: Each GAS read is now its own variable, but the precompile line does not show its gas argument. So 12 '_N = gas_remaining' lines are printed and never read.
regressions.rule: Drop an assignment whose variable no printed line reads, or print the call's gas argument with that variable.
regressions.verified: reading only (no later use of each variable in its function)

improvements: Rotated zero-initialisation loops (P3) are now do-whiles without a peeled iteration. Two Panic(17) checks in unknownf1faff00 ('34 > len + 52n + len2 + 198'), which the allocation bounds make impossible, are dropped exactly. Values resolve: the sha256 input copy length is '_309 + 33', b[i - 1] = hash4, the Array length of the attestation call is '20 * _21 + 52 * _30 + _45 + 164', and the revert selectors and 0x01... constants show whole bytes.
notes: Diff of 2,260 lines, read by function (4 changed). Calls, events and storage writes are unchanged. whiles 35 -> 41: in each of the three big functions, two zero-initialisations of a 2-element struct array that the old text unrolled are now do-whiles with 'u = 2' (neutral, the bytecode's loop). Pointer differences with two names for one pointer remain, as before (sha256 'len _308 + _309 - _311 + 33', the 0x11 call 'len _373 - _374 + 128'). unknowneb97cd2c's addresses grow into closed forms of _5/_11 (neutral).
summary: One low regression: 12 unused '_N = gas_remaining' lines before the bigModExp precompile calls. Otherwise improvements: P3 loops re-rolled, two impossible Panic(17) checks dropped, several lengths and values resolved.
